_doc: The pause plan of the pointing voice (read by pt_build.py and pt_verify.py). Every value is TRUE silence (10 ms RMS windows under -45 dBFS) between the acoustic end of one line and the start of the next. Decided from the picture column of sound/pointing/SCRIPT_v2.md so the voice never changes after Gate 1 (PIPELINE_V3 A2). Reasons per pause in _why.

_sections.8: setback: New York does it too

_why.lead_s: frame 0 = the glove already mid-snap and the loop seam from 'gone': the call comes at once
_why.tail_s: the brief: ~0.8 s after 'Bag... gone.' to end the video (his finger enters the phone screen), then the cut to frame 0
_why.d01|t01: pull back out of the phone to the tourist; his laugh starts the line
_why.t01|n01: the narrator answers the doubter at once
_why.n01|n02: slow push in on his grin, then the camera lifts and glides backward
_why.n02|n03: hold on the boy at the cab glass on 'one tiny fan'
_why.n03|d02: the glove points at the speedometer as the needle settles, then the call
_why.d02|n04: the glove snaps; the boy copies a beat late
_why.n04|d03: the glove rises to the door-closed lamp
_why.d03|t02: the lamp lights; side view along the platform: the doors slide shut (the plant), then the next station's door chime
_why.t02|t03: he pats the handle, hops onto the platform, phone up (the bag must read 2 s in the doorway)
_why.n06|n07: the sight gag: doors open on a tunnel wall, a commuter looks out, checks his map, looks back (hold 3 s)
_why.n07|n08: next stop: no board in sight
_why.n08|t04: the doors stay shut, passengers wait, one taps his watch
_why.n08|t05: used only if 'Vending machine... check!' is cut (cut order 1)
_why.t04|t05: two-shot: he grins into his phone, the boy frowns
_why.t05|n09: the loop line lands; the kitchen at night
_why.n09|n10: the question hangs (the hand on the door, the stove knobs all off)
_why.n11|n12: hold the final 6 vs 1 jars and the -85 % chip (a pause after a number)
_why.n13|d04: the glove rises toward the door lamp
_why.d04|k01: the brief: hold ~1 s on the doors shutting with the suitcase inside; the train starts to glide
_why.k01|t06: 'after a beat': he lowers his phone, then lifts it again
_why.sentence_gaps.t02: 'Stay.' (pats the handle like a dog) 'Be right back.'
_why.lift_db.t06: the tourist last line is small and flat (script 5.1): 1.5 dB under the other lines
